description: Department of Census and Statistics - Notifying that the National Consumer Price Index for the month of May 2016 was 113.7
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for May 2016, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content is purely statistical information, making it a miscellaneous administrative matter.
